description: Publish and unpublish Appcues flows, manage segments and their users, update user and group profiles, track events, export event data, and follow new flows, segments and finished jobs.

appcues_flow_published_trigger.description: Runs each time a flow is published.

output.flow: The record returned by the service

appcues_flow_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a flow is changed, published or unpublished.

output.flow: The record returned by the service

appcues_job_finished_trigger.description: Runs when an offline job, such as an export or a segment change, completes or fails.

output.job: The record returned by the service

appcues_new_flow_trigger.description: Runs when a flow is created.

output.flow: The record returned by the service

appcues_new_segment_trigger.description: Runs when a user segment is created.

output.segment: The record returned by the service

appcues_new_tag_trigger.description: Runs when a tag is created.

output.tag: The record returned by the service

appcues_segment_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a segment is renamed or its description changes.

output.segment: The record returned by the service
